race.comment: HISTORY WON'T CARE (1) comes into this first-up but without a trial., though he did the same thing last campaign and closed strongly in what ended up being a strong form race. The wide draw is no issue and CJP's booking is a good push for his chances. Can resume with a bang. STRIDEAWAY (4) was 588 days between runs when first-up but ran a strong race, beaten 2.1L when closing nicely. Should be better for that effort and she is a second-up winner in the past. Likely to get back once again, but she can close off strongly now she's knocked the rust off. DELZEE (6) disappointed two back, but beat STRIDEAWAY last start when only 1.8L off the winner. Has stacks of upside and should get every chance from the outset. SATURDAY SESH (2) is better than he showed last start and can improve third-up. CABLE ROCK (5) is hard to knock on his recent form and can't be left out of calculations.
